## Contributing

Pull requests are ignored to avoid licensing issues when reusing the code.

You can contribute by filing detailed and well-written bug reports.

## GitHub Issues Rules

Please review these rules before contributing.

- **Use English**, so people can find, understand, and contribute to issues globally.
- **Do not post EXE files** as it often becomes a security issue.
- **Stick to one topic per issue.** Keep discussions focused and relevant to the original subject. If a new topic arises, create a separate issue to address it. This is especially crucial when commenting on issues created by others.
